Example 11K Data Set

Source: R/data.R
example_data_11k.Rd

The example_data_11k object is intended to provide existing and prospective SomaLogic customers with example data to enable analysis preparation prior to receipt of SomaScan data, and also for those generally curious about the SomaScan data deliverable. It is not intended to be used as a control group for studies or provide any metrics for SomaScan data in general.

Source

https://github.com/SomaLogic/SomaLogic-Data/blob/main/example_data_v5.0_plasma.adat
